description: Minimum and maximum amount for a route, in the asset you send.

from.description: asset slug you send, e.g. usdt-trc20

mode.description: standard (default), or private: the swap runs as two legs at two liquidity partners through an intermediate coin; the limits then cover both legs

to.description: asset slug you receive, e.g. btc

via.description: private mode only: the intermediate coin slug; omitted → the server picks among sol, trx, ltc; xmr on request (the hop runs on Monero)

name: get_limits
title: Minimum and maximum
